boss.ember_warden.name: THE EMBER WARDEN
dialogue.maren_intro: There you are again. Ash to ash, and then back to you. Sit by the fire, little ember.
dialogue.maren_first_death: The first fall hurts the most. The Glut you carried back feeds the tree. Let me show you.
dialogue.maren_first_win: The Warden has fallen? Then the rift burns deeper than I feared. Rest. Then go further.
dialogue.maren_killed_warden: The Ember Warden has watched over the wastes since there were wastes. Its charge is wide, but its commitment is total. Dodge late.
dialogue.maren_killed_brute: A Shard Colossus? Its blow is slow. Be faster, and strike while it recovers.
dialogue.maren_killed_layer: Mines. Never stand where a Cinder Layer is looking.
dialogue.maren_killed_slag: Slag. The smallest things in the wastes. And still, here you are.
dialogue.maren_ignara: You smell of Ignara. She gives a lot, but she wants fire in return.
dialogue.maren_vaelis: Frost on your hands. Vaelis says little, but she listens to everything.
dialogue.maren_reached_boss: You stood before the Warden. Closer than most ever get.
dialogue.maren_runs5: Five times back from the ash. The tree grows with you, and so do you.
dialogue.maren_runs10: Some ask why you keep going. I stopped asking.
dialogue.maren_wins3: Three times through the wastes. The others have started telling stories about you.
dialogue.maren_filler_1: The fire's warm. The rift isn't going anywhere.
dialogue.maren_filler_2: Eat something. Even the branded need to eat.
dialogue.maren_filler_3: Every scar you bring back is a lesson. Read them.
dialogue.maren_filler_4: The embers whisper your name at night. I've learned to ignore it. Mostly.
dialogue.nix_intro: Well, well. A customer. I'm Nix. I have things. You have... dust? We'll get along.
dialogue.nix_dust: Elites carry rift dust inside them. Bring it to me and I'll put new relics in your path.
dialogue.nix_won: The Warden's down? Then its dust is free. Excellent for business.
dialogue.nix_killed_mite: Taken out by mites. I won't tell anyone. Almost anyone.
dialogue.nix_runs3: You know what I like about you? You always come back. Good customer.
dialogue.nix_reached_boss: You saw the big one, didn't you? I can tell. You've got that look.
dialogue.nix_filler_1: Browse all you like. Touching is extra.
dialogue.nix_filler_2: Prices are fair. Fair for me, anyway.
dialogue.nix_filler_3: If you find anything shiny out there, you know where I am.
dialogue.nix_filler_4: I'd come along, but someone has to mind the shop. And stay alive.

tree.rune_lore.desc: Your active spell starts each run at level 2.
dialogue.sel_intro: Sit still a moment. The Brand on your skin isn't a wound, it's a script. I can teach you to read a few lines of it.
dialogue.sel_teach: Every spell is a pattern. Bring me what you find out there, and I'll weave it into you for good.
dialogue.sel_won: The Warden fell and the pattern still holds. You're writing something new into it.
dialogue.sel_killed_duelist: The Duelist reads your blade, not your runes. Strike from behind, or let a spell do the talking.
dialogue.sel_killed_twins: Spark and Ash are one pattern in two bodies. Cut the thread between them first.
dialogue.sel_killed_twins_ash: Ash is slow, but never alone for long. Pull them apart, then finish one quickly.
dialogue.sel_ignara: Ignara's fire spills into everything you cast. Careful: flames like to spread to their weaver.
dialogue.sel_vaelis: Vaelis's cold sharpens your focus. Spells come back faster when the mind is still.
dialogue.sel_runs3: Three returns. Your runes are getting louder. I can almost hear them from up here.
dialogue.sel_runs8: Patterns repeat until someone changes them. I think that someone might be you.
dialogue.sel_reached_boss: You stood before the Warden. Next time, bring a spell it hasn't seen yet.
dialogue.sel_filler_1: A meteor is just a promise the sky keeps. Aim it well.
dialogue.sel_filler_2: Auras are patient spells. Let them work while you fight.
dialogue.sel_filler_3: Rune Shards out there? Each one is a sentence. Collect enough and the spell speaks louder.
dialogue.sel_filler_4: Light, poison, frost, flame. Every school asks for a different kind of patience.
